messages.content: I'm 44 and twisted my ankle while carrying a laundry basket. The outer ankle is painful with mild swelling. I have no open wound, deformity, numbness, or midfoot pain. Touching the tips and back edges of the ankle bones is not painful. I could not take four steps immediately after the twist and still cannot take four steps now because of pain.
